annotations.description: With only 1 land on the battlefield on turn 4, discarding a land is costly. Mountain provides a free untapped land drop, while Hired Claw is the weakest card in hand - a 1/2 that doesn't contribute much to the aggressive burn plan with Boros Charm, Lightning Helix, and Slickshot Show-Off.
annotations.betterLine: Discard Hired Claw instead. Being stuck on 1 land is a critical situation where every land matters. Sacred Foundry costs 2 life to come in untapped, so Mountain as a free untapped source is valuable. Hired Claw is the least impactful card for a burn-oriented aggro plan.

annotations.description: GPT5m Perfect is at 9 life facing an opponent at 16 life with Inti (4/3 with Bloodthorn Flail) and Bloodghast on board. Shock deals 2 damage to the opponent's face (16→14), but this doesn't set up lethal and wastes a burn spell. The opponent has Inti equipped with Bloodthorn Flail as a 4/3 - this is the primary threat that will attack for 4+ damage each turn with trample and card advantage from discard triggers. Killing Inti with Shock (2 damage) won't work since it has 3 toughness, but Bloodghast is a 2/1 that keeps recurring from the graveyard via landfall, so targeting it is also inefficient. However, looking at the board state more carefully - GPT5m Perfect has Lightning Helix and Boros Charm in hand. Shock (2) + Lightning Helix (3) + Boros Charm (4) = 9 damage to face, bringing opponent from 16 to 7. That's not lethal. But preserving Shock for a creature later or combining it with Lightning Helix to kill Inti (2+3=5 damage, Inti has 3 toughness so either alone would need to do 3) - actually Inti is a 4/3 with the flail, so 3 toughness. Lightning Helix alone kills Inti. So Shock to face is reasonable as pure burn if going face is the plan. But at 9 life facing significant board pressure, going face with 2 damage when you're behind on board and life total seems questionable. The Shock could be better used defensively or saved to combine with other spells for value. Going face when you're losing the race and behind on board is generally wrong.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted Grk41F Teach (opponent's face) with Shock for 2 damage
annotations.betterLine: Target Bloodghast with Shock to remove a recurring attacker, or save Shock for a more impactful moment. With Lightning Helix in hand to handle Inti and the life gain to stabilize, removing board threats is more important than 2 face damage when behind at 9 life.

annotations.description: Playing Restless Vents (enters tapped) instead of Swamp (enters untapped) wastes the opportunity to cast Greasewrench Goblin this turn. With opponent at 9 life and no blockers, deploying an additional creature maximizes pressure and sets up lethal next turn more reliably.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Restless Vents, which enters tapped, leaving no ability to cast Greasewrench Goblin this turn.
annotations.betterLine: Play Swamp (enters untapped), then cast Greasewrench Goblin with a Blazemire Verge for R. Attack with Inti + Bloodghast for 7+ damage this turn, and have Goblin ready to attack next turn for a cleaner kill.

annotations.description: The opponent is at 9 life. Monument to Endurance's third mode 'Each opponent loses 3 life' would deal 3 damage, bringing them to 6. With Inti (5/4 with equipment, possibly bigger with counters), Bloodghast (2/1 with haste since opponent is at 10 or less), and Restless Vents attacking, plus potential burn from exiled cards, choosing 'Draw a card' over 'Each opponent loses 3 life' passes up guaranteed damage that could be the difference between winning and losing. At 9 life, 3 direct life loss is extremely impactful and could set up lethal this turn or next. Drawing a card is speculative value when you're already in a dominant position with lethal threats on board.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose 'Draw a card' from Monument to Endurance's trigger.
annotations.betterLine: Choose 'Each opponent loses 3 life' to drop opponent from 9 to 6 life, making lethal much easier with the existing board of attackers and potentially closing the game immediately.
